title: Boolean-Dependent Tape Action
statement: Let $r_1,r_2$ be work-tape indices, let $e_B,l$ be states, and let $a$ be either a Boolean symbol or blank. If $a$ is a symbol, the action moves the two indexed work-tape heads one cell left and enters $e_B$; if $a$ is blank, it moves them one cell right and enters $l$. In both cases it leaves the input head stationary, writes nothing, and emits no output symbol.
